newsitem.title: USA: Laser Technology sees '97 EPS trailing '96.
newsitem.headline: Laser Technology sees '97 EPS trailing '96.

text.p: Laser Technology Inc said Friday it expects its earnings for the fiscal year ending September 30 will trail prior-year levels.

However, President and Chief Executive David Williams said in a statement he believes expanded marketing efforts and investments in new technology "will allow revenues and profitability to improve significantly during the current quarter and the upcoming fiscal year."
In the 1996 fiscal year, the company reported net income of $1.06 million, or $0.20 per share, on revenues of $9.31 million.

In the third quarter ended June 30, the company posted net income of $7,899, or nil per share, on revenues of close to $2 million. For the same period in the prior year, the company reported net income of $35,952, or $0.01 per share, on revenue of $1.65 million.
Laser Technology manufactures and markets laser-based speed and distance-measuring instruments.
